response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of hands-on software development with genuine developer-tooling depth — he authored a D test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), built CI/CD and DevOps infrastructure, and taught test-automation courses — which maps well to the engineering productivity focus. However, the resume shows no evidence of formal people management: there are no direct reports, no hiring/performance-review responsibility, and no organizational-change leadership, all of which are explicit minimum requirements for a Level II Manager role. Titles like Staff/Senior Engineer and Founder imply influence and mentorship (workshops, dojos, community teaching) rather than line management. He is a plausible candidate for a first-time manager stretch, but a screening call would be needed to confirm any unlisted leadership scope and his interest in leaving hands-on IC work.
strengths: Deep developer-tools and test-infrastructure track record (test runner, assertion library, CI/CD, Selenium curriculum)
15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput microservices
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing via workshops, conference talks, and open-source project founding
concerns: No documented people-management experience or direct reports (2-year minimum unmet)
No evidence of roadmap ownership, performance management, or organizational-change leadership
Limited recent mobile-platform ecosystem exposure; iOS work dates back to 2015-2016

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and test infrastructure expertise
